rec.name: Cart Free Gift with Progress Bar (€0 Gift Line Item)
rec.status: Built — live in theme, but customer deactivated it; €0 pricing needs a discount app (workaround proposed, awaiting customer feedback)

what.text: A free-gift mechanic in the cart drawer/cart page. The cart progress bar has two milestones (free shipping and free gift). When the customer reaches the threshold, a message appears ("Congratulations! Add your free gift!") and the chosen gift product shows in the cart as a line item at €0.00. The gift line has a Remove link, so customers can decline it. Per the ticket history, the gift is no longer shown with a quantity selector.

why.text: A free gift gives shoppers a tangible reward for hitting a spend threshold. The progress bar makes the goal visible (goal-gradient effect) and nudges people to add items to reach it, which raises AOV. Showing the gift at €0.00 reinforces the 'free' framing (reciprocity). Letting people remove the gift keeps them in control and avoids friction or distrust.

how.text: 1) Add the gift milestone to the cart progress bar next to the free-shipping milestone, with a congratulation message. 2) Add the designated gift product to the cart when the threshold is met and show it at €0.00 with a Remove link. 3) To make the price truly €0 at checkout without cloning the product, use a discount app (e.g. 'Every Possible Discount') that discounts the gift SKU by 100% when the cart condition is met. Theme code alone can only display €0 and does not change the checkout price. A first build charged the gift at checkout for this reason. 4) Cloning the product to a €0 variant breaks inventory when stock is managed externally (here JTL, where a clone drove stock negative), so avoid it in such setups.

items: Free shipping bar on/off toggle (visible in theme settings)
Free shipping minimum amount (example: 60 in store currency)
Cart heading, cart sub-heading, subtotal text, delivery title/value/duration text, drawer button label (visible in theme settings)

Free gift product, gift threshold and gift message: the ticket does not show a settings panel for these, and a team member noted they could not find a Free Gift setting. The gift threshold is likely configured in the discount app or in code
Show/hide Remove button on the gift line (enabled on request)

dependencies.text: Needs a discount app that can set a specific product to €0 in the cart (e.g. Every Possible Discount) to avoid cloning the product. The gift product must be a real SKU so inventory stays correct. The client syncs Shopify with JTL, which manages inventory, so a €0 clone is not an option. Needs the cart drawer/cart page theme with a progress bar (the Sectionfy live theme in the screenshots). The exact gift-product metafield or setting is not documented.

items: Share of orders that include the free gift
Share of carts reaching the gift threshold
Cart-to-checkout rate and checkout conversion rate
Inventory accuracy / negative stock incidents for gift SKUs
Checkout support complaints about the gift being charged

images.caption: Cart drawer with a two-milestone progress bar (shipping + gift), the message 'Glückwunsch! Füge Dein gratis Geschenk hinzu!', and the Lion Felt Mask at €0,00 with a Remove link.

Cart line items: the gift (Löwe Filzmaske) at €0,00 compared with a paid product that has a quantity selector and 'Entfernen'. The annotations mark the missing remove control on the gift (fixed later).
Theme settings for the free shipping bar (toggle, minimum amount 60, cart texts). No dedicated Free Gift setting is visible here.
